description: Version 1.18, gripper only (builds on 1.17, related: voice-cfdf2d31): Correction to 1.17: the fingers SHOULD taper in thickness toward the tip like the Generalist reference gripper does. But keep one face flat so it's easy to 3D print: the taper goes down from one side only (a flat bottom with the top sloping down toward the tip), not a symmetric taper toward the midplane. Reference images: cad/reference/generalist_gripper_gen6_closed.png and references/generalist.
